sources.quote: Rho Pegasi, Latinized from ρ Pegasi, also named Leidian, is a star in the northern constellation of Pegasus, near the southern constellation boundary with Pisces.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.4 solar radii and 2.85 solar masses (FLAME) and 10,006 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
